user.title: Danfoss Link
user.description: Enter the app certificate and private key from the Danfoss Link Android app, plus your CC peer ID. You can paste PEM text or a file path Home Assistant can read (e.g. /config/danfoss_link_creds/app_cert.pem). See the project documentation for how to export credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to your Danfoss Link CC. Close the Danfoss app on your phone/emulator, check the peer ID and PEM files, then try again.
